name: @didz/didz-contract
description: TypeScript bindings + Vitest simulators for DIDzRegistry + TrustedIssuerRegistry Compact contracts

scripts.compact: compact compile ../contracts/DIDzRegistry.compact src/managed/didz-registry && compact compile ../contracts/TrustedIssuerRegistry.compact src/managed/trusted-issuer-registry
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/managed 2>/dev/null || true
